disposition_semantics.validation: input or candidate state illegal — fix the input, retry as a NEW operation (写前完整验证: schema + 跨记录约束)
disposition_semantics.conflict: concurrent/intent mismatch — return observed state + reason, caller re-judges (CAS 冲突不自动换版本执行)
disposition_semantics.retryable: transient — the SAME operation may be retried
disposition_semantics.manual: human intervention required (credential repair / projection rebuild / recovery adjudication)

code_grounding.schema_violation: 写前完整验证 (arch round-2 §5: 先算候选结果再校验 schema)
code_grounding.cross_record_violation: 写前完整验证 (arch round-2 §5: +跨记录约束)
code_grounding.schema_version_unsupported: 旧 CLI 遇新 schema 拒写 (version-plan §2 M0 line)
code_grounding.operation_id_conflict: 同 ID 不同输入拒绝 (arch round-2 §1)
code_grounding.lock_contention: 短时存储写入锁 busy (arch round-2 §1 — retryable)
code_grounding.manual_intervention: 需介入 (arch round-2 §5 DoD item 5; 凭据修复/投影重建/恢复裁决)

closed_enum_rule: unknown codes fail closed — extend ERROR_CODE_DISPOSITIONS deliberately, never emit ad-hoc codes
